description: Each equipment status's average pulse rate is the mean of per-telescope average pulse rates, each telescope weighted equally.

c.request: Link each signal to its telescope (`signals.telescref` = `telescopes.telescregistry`), and drop signals with no matching telescope. For each equipment status (`telescopes.equipstatus`), what is the average pulse rate (`signals.pulsepersec`) of the telescopes in that status, based on the signals they detected and ignoring missing pulse rates? Keep the statuses whose average is above the mean of all the status averages, and note how far above it each one is. From those, keep only the statuses whose average is above the mean of the kept ones, again noting the excess. Give one row with three values: the average pulse rate of the final statuses, their average excess over the first mean, and their average excess over the second mean. Don't round. Each equipment status's average pulse rate is the mean of per-telescope average pulse rates, each telescope weighted equally.
c.sql:
WITH per_telescope AS (
  SELECT t.equipstatus, t.telescregistry, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM signals AS s
  JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.equipstatus, t.telescregistry
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT equipstatus, AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM per_telescope
  GROUP BY equipstatus
), first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM status_averages
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate,
         sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_rate AS excess_first
  FROM status_averages AS sa
  CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm
  WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_rate
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate FROM first_kept
), final_kept AS (
  SELECT fk.avg_pulse_rate, fk.excess_first,
         fk.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_rate AS excess_second
  FROM first_kept AS fk
  CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm
  WHERE fk.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean
FROM final_kept;

b.request: For each equipment status, average each matching telescope’s non-null signal pulse rates, then take the unweighted mean of those per-telescope averages; retain statuses whose average exceeds the unweighted mean across all status averages, compute each retained status’s excess over that mean, then retain those whose average exceeds the unweighted mean of the first retained statuses’ averages and compute their excess over that second mean; return one row containing the unweighted mean of the final statuses’ averages, their unweighted mean excess over the first mean, and their unweighted mean excess over the second mean, without rounding
b.sql:
WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT t.telescregistry,
         t.equipstatus,
         AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN signals AS s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT equipstatus, AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM telescope_averages
  GROUP BY equipstatus
), first_retained AS (
  SELECT equipstatus, avg_pulse_rate,
         avg_pulse_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) FROM status_averages) AS excess_over_first_mean
  FROM status_averages
  WHERE avg_pulse_rate > (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) FROM status_averages)
), second_retained AS (
  SELECT equipstatus, avg_pulse_rate, excess_over_first_mean,
         avg_pulse_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) FROM first_retained) AS excess_over_second_mean
  FROM first_retained
  WHERE avg_pulse_rate > (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) FROM first_retained)
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_final_status_average,
       AVG(excess_over_first_mean) AS mean_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(excess_over_second_mean) AS mean_excess_over_second_mean
FROM second_retained;

a.request: Match each signal to its telescope via `signals.telescref` = `telescopes.telescregistry`, and drop signals without a matching telescope. For each equipment status (`telescopes.equipstatus`), compute the average pulse rate (`signals.pulsepersec`), by first averaging pulse rate per telescope (ignoring missing pulse rates) and then averaging those telescope averages, so each telescope counts once. Take the mean of these status averages and keep the statuses whose average is above it, noting how far above each one is. Then take the mean of the kept statuses' averages and keep only the statuses whose average is above that second mean, again noting how far above each one is. Return one row with three values: the average pulse-rate average of the remaining statuses, their average excess over the first mean, and their average excess over the second mean. Don't round.
a.sql:
WITH telescope_averages AS (
  SELECT t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN signals AS s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT equipstatus, AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM telescope_averages
  GROUP BY equipstatus
), first_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM status_averages
), first_kept AS (
  SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate, sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_rate AS excess_first
  FROM status_averages AS sa
  CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm
  WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_rate
), second_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_rate
  FROM first_kept
), remaining AS (
  SELECT fk.avg_pulse_rate, fk.excess_first, fk.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_rate AS excess_second
  FROM first_kept AS fk
  CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm
  WHERE fk.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_remaining_status_pulse_rate,
       AVG(excess_first) AS avg_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(excess_second) AS avg_excess_over_second_mean
FROM remaining;

d.request: Link each signal to its telescope (`signals.telescref` = `telescopes.telescregistry`) and drop signals with no matching telescope. For each equipment status (`telescopes.equipstatus`), calculate the average of the per-telescope average pulse rates (`signals.pulsepersec`), weighting each telescope equally and ignoring missing pulse rates. Keep statuses whose average is above the mean of all status averages, then keep only those whose average is above the mean of the first set. What are the final statuses’ average pulse rate, their average excess over the first mean, and their average excess over the second mean? Return one row with those three values, without rounding.
d.sql:
WITH per_telescope AS (
  SELECT t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN signals AS s ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  WHERE s.pulsepersec IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus
), status_averages AS (
  SELECT equipstatus, AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate
  FROM per_telescope
  GROUP BY equipstatus
), first_set AS (
  SELECT * FROM status_averages
  WHERE avg_pulse_rate > (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) FROM status_averages)
), second_set AS (
  SELECT * FROM first_set
  WHERE avg_pulse_rate > (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) FROM first_set)
)
SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS average_pulse_rate,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) FROM status_averages)) AS average_excess_over_first_mean,
       AVG(avg_pulse_rate - (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) FROM first_set)) AS average_excess_over_second_mean
FROM second_set;
